# Mochy Music player styles — vendored source

This directory preserves the five original Kotlin source files from Mochy Music's player styles package:

- [AlternatePlayerStyles.kt](app/src/main/kotlin/com/mochyy/mochymusic/ui/player/styles/AlternatePlayerStyles.kt)
- [CoverRing.kt](app/src/main/kotlin/com/mochyy/mochymusic/ui/player/styles/CoverRing.kt)
- [ExpressiveText.kt](app/src/main/kotlin/com/mochyy/mochymusic/ui/player/styles/ExpressiveText.kt)
- [StyleKit.kt](app/src/main/kotlin/com/mochyy/mochymusic/ui/player/styles/StyleKit.kt)
- [StyleLyricsPage.kt](app/src/main/kotlin/com/mochyy/mochymusic/ui/player/styles/StyleLyricsPage.kt)

**Upstream:** [InlitX/Mochy-Music](https://github.com/InlitX/Mochy-Music/tree/main/app/src/main/kotlin/com/mochyy/mochymusic/ui/player/styles)

**License:** GNU General Public License v3.0. See [LICENSE](LICENSE). Copyright remains with the original project and its contributors.

These are preserved as upstream reference sources, not compiled directly into KatMusic: the original package depends on Mochy-only player, carousel, lyrics, resources and preference APIs. KatMusic's adapted player implementation lives in its own player module and is marked separately as modified.
